scope: renderer-neutral inventory windowing anchor boundary fix only

tests.evidence: Observed completed test runner output; deterministic algorithm/count tests only.

regressions: Exact two-section 220px boundary with 32px descriptions / 20px headers; deltas -20/-15/-10/-5 and adjacent description/header positions.
Unchanged-model identity round trip for every valid integer scroll offset, sticky chrome offsets 0/10, viewport heights 60/95, measured header heights 31/17.
Captured description body edge preserved across preceding product collapse and measured warehouse-height reflow.
Normal warehouse-row offset5 remains at the current body edge after measured header growth20→40 or shrink20→8, with sticky chrome0/10 and preceding product collapse.
Description-boundary anchor identity remains visible and recaptures the same row/offset when header heights grow20→40 or shrink20→7; pinned and pushed-off contexts are treated separately.
limitations: No network, database, install, commit or push.
anchorSemantics: Capture records the owning header section and pinned/push-off phase. Restore uses current height for fully pinned headers, captured partial occlusion clamped to current height for pushed-off headers, and chrome only when no header was active.
